serverInfo.name: abstractinator
serverInfo.title: The Abstractinator
serverInfo.description: Immunology and virology literature search across Europe PMC, OpenAlex, ClinicalTrials.gov, bioRxiv/medRxiv, NIH RePORTER grants and NSF awards, deduplicated and tagged by immune cell type, virus and bacterium; plus an open registry of therapeutic-virus programs (oncolytic viruses, phage therapies, gene therapies) with stable AXP IDs, linked trials, papers and grants, and weekly trial change events.

tools.name: search_literature
tools.description: Search immunology/virology literature across six biomedical databases at once. Returns deduplicated, source-balanced records tagged by immune cell type, virus and bacterium.

tools.name: get_fulltext
tools.description: Read the full text of one open-access article from Europe PMC, given a pmcid from a search result (or a DOI). Returns clean JATS section text. Paywalled articles return status not_open_access rather than an error.

tools.name: program
tools.description: Look up one therapy program in the registry by AXP ID or any name or code: its names, virus details, approvals, and the trials, papers and grants linked to it.

tools.name: changes
tools.description: What changed in the clinical trials of tracked programs, from weekly ClinicalTrials.gov snapshots: new trials, status and phase changes, results posted, slipped completion dates.
